tolerance_policy.readout_policy: Record readable intervals; hidden arrays never set pixel-exact numeric expectations.

F01.budget_ticks: Read actual labeled tick values and scale; do not infer linear increments from pixel spacing.

F02.interval_overlap: Evaluate visually resolvable order/overlap only; statistical significance/equivalence requires separate evidence.

F03.unit: Read original axis unit; preserve logarithmic/linear role.

F04.group_direction: Assess each legend group separately and pooled relation; no causal parameter is observed.

tolerance_policy.regions: Accept reasonable actual-source regions covering the relevant axes/marks/legend, not hidden author coordinates.
tolerance_policy.unknown: Missing quality, pairing statistics or causal experiment stays unknown; do not fill0 or invent adverse experiment.

root_integration_reading_policy: Consensus hulls describe the two actual pixel readings and are not stricter acceptance windows. Rounded visual anchors are not hidden exact truth. Any future root integration must honor the unchanged public reading_tolerance.json and explicit judgment-object semantics, rather than exact interval endpoints, wording or label frequency.

root_adoption.C04: Refute explicit proof-sufficiency; actual significance and equivalence remain unknown.
root_adoption.C06: Insufficient factual final-quality comparison; explicit refutation of low-latency-suffices metaclaim also admissible only while preserving actual lower latency and unknown quality.
root_adoption.C07: Do not erase within-group graphical counterevidence with generic uncertainty. Actual causal effect remains unknown.
root_adoption.absolute_author_paths: Historical provenance only; runtime uses the self-contained private evidence copies and source image hashes.
